title: PGP Public Key
help: An external party's OpenPGP public key — a recipient you encrypt to or a signer you verify. Not secret; can live in a plain registry path. Create one connection per party for isolation and independent rotation.

value.name: connectionName
value.helpTip: Unique name used to reference this key from operations.

value.name: publicKeyPath
value.helpTip: Public key-ring location, e.g. resources:keys/partner.asc (project resource, recommended). Also env:NAME, inline ASCII-armored content, or a file path. Legacy registry (gov:/..., conf:/...) is also supported.

value.name: keyIdentifier
value.helpTip: Which key to encrypt to: a full fingerprint (40 hex, e.g. from 'gpg --fingerprint'), a 16-hex 64-bit Key ID (e.g. 0x7B9E1A2C3D4E5F6A), or an exact user ID / e-mail (e.g. bob@example.com). Required for encryption; not used for signature verification (matched from the signature). Optional if the ring holds a single key.
